event_corrections.source: The blue J spawned at 160.9 locks ~161.5 and clears one coloured row (flash 161.6-162.0, no queue shift until 162.2); score 5340->5640 (+300, plain single) at 161.53. The single breaks B2B, which is why the TSD at 163.4 scored +3630 (non-B2B) instead of 5400. corr/fr/g1/i17.png; score.py 160-167 jeH2N-kjDUw

Vertical I at 332.0 into the 4 grey garbage rows, TETRIS banner, 4-row flash 332.2-332.6, score 52948->56582 (+3634 = B2B quad). Not a T-spin. corr/fr/g1/i22.png

At ~333.7 the J is held and the T swapped out; the T locks ~334.3 into a T-spin Single ('Single' banner at 334.4-335.0, one-row flash 334.4), score 56679->60279 (+3600 = B2B TSS). Chain had this lock as a non-clear. corr/fr/g1/i22.png; score.py 329-334.5

Same window: vertical I on the left at 366.4, TETRIS banner, 4-row flash 366.65-366.9, score 101003->104621 (+3618 = B2B quad); a 4-line clear cannot be a mini. gc kept as the chain had it (2). corr/fr/g1/i24.png

Green S spawned ~31.7 locks and clears one coloured row (flash 31.85-32.0), REN banner appears; REN counter then reads 2 REN at 32.9 after the 32.6 single and 7 REN at 37.4 after the 37.2 single, which needs this clear. corr/fr/g1/i27d.png, i27c.png

Orange L spawned 40.7 locks ~40.85 and clears one coloured row (flash 40.9-41.2, TETRIS banner from the previous quad still showing), score 30204->32154 (+1950 = single 300 + REN 11 x150). This single breaks B2B, so the TSD at 44.27 scored +3605 (non-B2B) rather than 5400: that is the unexplained -1749. corr/fr/g1/i27b.png, i27.png
Banner T-SPIN Triple and score 31836->39036 at 86.37 (+7200 = B2B TST after the 83.1 quad; B2B TSS would be 3600). score.py 82-91 lK7Nd8Nqh1c. gc kept 0 as chain.

The T at 87.7 spins into the bottom-left notch; no row clears (rows identical at 87.8 and 88.1), banner is a bare 'T-SPIN' (mini, zero lines), score 39049->39349 (+300 = zero-line mini). B2B survives: the TSD at 89.67 scores +5400. corr/fr/g1/i30.png
